_comment: Example configuration for using Netease Cloud Music with mob-battle-music
_comment2: You can use either the song page URL or the direct audio URL

_field_descriptions.external_url: Can be either a Netease Cloud Music song page URL (https://music.163.com/song?id=XXXXX) or a direct audio URL
_field_descriptions.type: The type of track (mob_specific, mob_list, mob_tag, player_specific, player_specific_uuid)
_field_descriptions.mob: The entity type this music should play for
_field_descriptions.priority: Priority for this track (higher priority tracks play first)
_field_descriptions.fade_time: Time in ticks for the music to fade in/out (20 ticks = 1 second)
_field_descriptions.selector: How to select mobs (NEAREST, RANDOM, ALL)

_notes: Netease Cloud Music URLs are automatically resolved to direct audio URLs
The system will convert this to: http://music.163.com/song/media/outer/url?id={SONG_ID}
Downloaded files are cached locally to avoid repeated downloads
Example song ID from your URL: 29497060
